title: Chest pain triage
goal: Show an educational chest-pain assessment tree leading to clear clinical dispositions.

rubric.must: The unstable-or-severe-pain Yes branch visibly tests for STEMI and routes STEMI to immediate reperfusion.
The stable branch visibly tests ECG or troponin concern before routing possible acute coronary syndrome to monitored assessment.
The low-risk alternative-diagnosis path visibly ends in discharge with safety-net advice and follow-up.
An uncertain low-risk assessment visibly leads to serial-testing observation.
Each internal node is visibly phrased as a clinical assessment question.
